author: NBCPhiladelphia
title: China urges Beijing-backed development bank to focus more on Belt and Road Initiative
text:
Chinese Premier Li Qiang called on the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank to increase its support for Beijing’s Belt and Road Initiative.
Chinese Premier Li Qiang's speech comes amid a pullback of U.S. support for Western-led institutions such as the World Bank and the IMF.The AIIB provides loans to developing countries, largely for infrastructure projects such as water supply and transportation.
"It is important to strengthen the synergy between the bank and the Belt and Road Initiative and Global Development Initiative," Li said, referring to two Beijing-led programs.for Western-led institutions such as the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund, which U.S. President Donald Trump claims unfairly benefit other nations.
"China is also very aware that the U.S. is trying to pressure countries to tilt away from China and this is part of its strategy to counteract those efforts," Olson said in an email.Under Chinese President Xi Jinping, now in his third term, China launched a regional development program called the Belt and Road Initiative in 2013.
